title: MACHINES IN THE PLAYER 2 WINDOW COME BACK FROM A BROKEN SPOT
why: Found by the spare PC robots (p2:nan, two runs on 34.83, none since): in the player 2 window a few machines ended up at a spot that was not a number, so they vanished from the screen and never came back while the host kept sending their real spot. The step that slides a copy toward the host spot and the check that snaps a copy that is far off both stay broken on such a spot. A copy at a broken spot now snaps straight to the host spot on the next frame.
now: In a two player raid, a machine that drops out of the player 2 window comes back on the next frame instead of staying gone.
